title: Industry's first self-evolving financial large model debuts: Du Xiaoman partners with HKUST to release Xuanyuan 4.5

content_html:
On November 2, at the opening ceremony of Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026, Du Xiaoman, together with the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) and the Hong Kong Generative AI Research and Development Center (HKGAI), officially released the new Xuanyuan 4.5 Financial-Enhanced Large Model. As a major innovation in the financial vertical, this model, powered by innovative RSI technology, has improved results by 30% in core financial scenarios such as customer acquisition, risk control, and customer operations, while its inference cost is only 10% of that of general-purpose models.
